notes.title: Brie Parmesan is due for an update
notes.content:
Work is ongoing

A massive update to Brie Parmesan Mysteries- complete with sweeping improvements to our game’s core internals- is on the verge of release! We want to acknowledge the recent challenges and apologize for the extended period without an update; good things take time, and this update is no different!



Early Access

Its all about seeing how people play and improving the experience.  Brie Parmesan Mysteries is no different. The dev team was pulled in multiple directions with the demo release of Kibble Game Studios 'Plastic Tactics Online' Demo but we're back at it looking to continue polishing the gameplay experience, address bugs, prepare the title for additional content launches and enhance the overall experience. We're absolutely thrilled to announce that a significant patch is on the way, and can’t wait to hear from our dedicated community on ways we can continue to improve the experience.

Your patience and support mean the world to us. We're committed to delivering the best possible experience to our murine sleuths, and we're grateful for your patience and support as we continue to build Brie Parmesan Mysteries into the quality title we are intent on delivering to our players.
Stay tuned for more details, and thank you for being such an important part of our community! Brie Parmesan Mysteries
